# EnterpriseGlue v0.21.2 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.21.1`.

## Highlights

- **frontend-host:** Stops the pooled SaaS platform-admin shell from requesting tenant-scoped notifications and engine inventory when no tenant route is active.

## User and administrator impact

- Platform administrators can open root administration pages without failing tenant notification or engine-inventory requests and their associated browser-console errors.
- Notifications and engine selection remain available in OSS mode and on explicit tenant routes in pooled SaaS mode.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Upgrade the frontend image; no backend, configuration, or data changes are required.

## Database migrations

- This frontend-only fix does not change TypeORM entities, migrations, or supported database behavior.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Tenant notification and engine-inventory data continue to be requested only through an explicit tenant context in pooled mode.

## Documentation

- The versioned release notes describe the platform-admin notification-context correction.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/frontend-host` | `0.16.2` | `0.16.3` | patch |

## Rollback

- Redeploy the preceding frontend image; no database or configuration rollback is required.

## Validation evidence

- Frontend component tests cover the pooled platform root, explicit tenant routes, unchanged OSS notification behavior, disabled engine inventory loading, and cached tenant engine data becoming unavailable outside a tenant context.
- The frontend-host TypeScript build check passes for the changed component.
